sources.title: ROM Siphusauctum gregarium; OBrien and Caron2012 PLOS ONE e29233 Fig17 and abstract
sources.license: ROM images copyrighted, consulted-only. Paper open-access CC Attribution; Fig17 credits Marianne Collins, treated consulted-only. No source pixels copied.
sources.notes: Original description https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0029233 . Abstract supports ovoid calyx, bilayered stem, small holdfast, six small basal openings and terminal anus. Actual ROM holotype thumbnail plus large Figure17 reconstruction pixels inspected before concept/freeze. Calyx shape and ports supported; color, wall thickness and exact proportions artistic. Paper discusses uncertain affinities; no settled phylum claim.
